headline.title: GLM-5.4发布：Z.ai首个循环Transformer模型，面向通用编码
headline.summary: 中国AI实验室Z.ai发布GLM-5.4，称其为首个采用循环Transformer架构的模型；该架构让一组共享权重层多次迭代，目标提升通用编码能力。
headline.title_en: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
headline.summary_en: Chinese AI lab Z.ai released GLM-5.4, its first model built on a looped transformer architecture in which weight-shared layers run for multiple iterations, aimed at generalized coding.
